title: Grand swirls — NGC 1566
changes: Original JPEG unchanged; colours and spiral texture mapped into an illustrative stellar volume with a thick disk, a distinct rounded warm stellar bulge and a subtle irregular midplane dust lane. Edge-on disk appearance is informed by NGC 4565 reference imagery, without importing that image. The galaxy and dusty torus share a common model plane, and the bulge is centred on the image nucleus. Added depth and the stellar bulge are artistic illustrations, not measured three-dimensional structure; nuclear overlays are not resolved features in the photograph.
